title: Simplification of Work Processes and Procedures
overview: This dynamic course is centered around the theme of "Going back to basics," helping participants recognize the importance of simplifying organizational processes and procedures. The course introduces international best practices to understand the root causes of complexity, focusing on eliminating waste, streamlining procedures, and exploring opportunities for standardization and automation. Participants will gain practical experience using tools to map and diagram processes, identifying issues and areas for improvement. By the end of the course, attendees will be equipped with hands-on tools to implement these strategies in their organizations, yielding immediate results.
audience: This course is designed for managers, supervisors, employees involved in the design or simplification of procedures, and end users seeking to optimize organizational efficiency.
methodology: The course is highly interactive, featuring hands-on exercises, case study analysis, presentations, group discussions, and plenary debriefs to enhance learning and practical application.
competencies: Understanding lean principles and waste reduction
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the principles of organizational design and their impact on complexity
Identify the effects of complex policies and procedures on organizations
Utilize flow charts and workflow techniques effectively
Compare various tools for process simplification and mapping
Analyze and optimize work distribution within organizational units
Evaluate the significance of office layout and processes in enhancing efficiency
